name: Oshiete Sensei Otoko no Ko Gakuen ~Icha Love! Otoko no Ko Triangle~
original_name: 教えて先生 オトコの娘学園～イチャラブ！男の娘トライアングル～
source: Hasegawa Nozuomu, the main character, will come to Shiraki Gakuen as a new teacher. After being appointed, the hero is told from the principle, "Our students are all special people and shouldn't interfere or hold them back" Nozuomu not completely understanding cryptic message soon finds out how special and different students are at academy.
translation: 主角长谷川望将作为新老师来到白木学园。被任命后，主人公被告知原则：“我们的学生都是特殊的人，不应该干涉或阻止他们。”野作没有完全理解神秘的信息，很快就发现了学院里的学生有多么特殊和不同。
